description: Four children each have a general anaesthetic with one systolic pressure of 50 on its record: an infant whose reading falls during the anaesthetic, a five-year-old with the same reading, an infant whose reading was taken an hour after the anaesthetic ended, and an infant whose reading the source marks as not accepted.

expectations.says: The anaesthetic table holds each of the four anaesthetics as a general anaesthetic.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS anaesthetics FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value IN ('990000131', '990000132', '990000133', '990000134') AND a.anaesthesia_type_concept_id = 4174669

expectations.says: The infant's reading of 50 is written as a systolic pressure that points at the anaesthetic and falls within its times.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000131' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249 AND m.value_as_number = 50 AND m.measurement_datetime BETWEEN a.start_datetime AND a.end_datetime

expectations.says: The five-year-old is five years old at the start of the anaesthetic, so the infant queries leave the reading out.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_years FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000132'

expectations.says: The reading taken an hour after the anaesthetic ended does not point at the anaesthetic, because it falls outside the margin after the end, and it still carries the anaesthetic's visit detail.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = m.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000133' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249 AND m.value_as_number = 50 AND m.measurement_event_id IS NULL

expectations.says: The reading that the source marks as not accepted is not written.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = m.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990000114'
